faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Everything you need to know about recovering your lost items safely.

partner.q: How can I partner with PataChako?
partner.a: Click on "Partner with Us" in the navigation menu and fill the partner form. You can partner with PataChako only if you are an organization such as a university, owner of a wedding hall, owner of a mall, or other places where many people gather.

report.q: How do I report a lost item?
report.a: Click on "Report Lost Item" in the navigation menu. Fill out the secure form with details about your item. Then wait for matching once your item is found.

search.q: How do I search for my item?
search.a: Use the "Search Found Items" feature to search by the region where you lost your item. If you find that your item belongs to a particular region, you can continue to report your item. If you don't find it but you are sure you lost your valuable item, just go to the Report Lost Item button to report.

claim.a: No. All claims require strict verification. You must provide proof of ownership, such as a lostReportId. You can then even share it with a friend for pickup.

verify.a: Our partnered organizations conduct a multi-step verification process, which may include lostReportId and answering specific questions about the item.

secure.a: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption for all data transmissions and adhere to strict privacy policies. Your contact details are never publicly displayed.

noLocation.q: What if I don't know the exact location?
noLocation.a: Provide the last known location or general area. Our system uses geolocation matching to alert you if an item is found nearby.

retention.a: Retention periods vary by partnering organization, but typically items are held securely for 30 to 90 days before being processed according to local regulations.

beOrganisation.q: How can I become an organization on PataChako?
beOrganisation.a: You can become an organization on PataChako only if you are the owner of a mall, hall, university, or any place where many people gather or events happen frequently.

free.a: Reporting and searching are completely free for individuals. We sustain the platform through premium verification services for large organizations.

testimonialsSection.title: Trusted by the Community
testimonialsSection.subtitle: Hear from people who have successfully recovered their valuable belongings.

shinuna.name: Shinuna Khamis
shinuna.text: I lost my student ID and laptop bag on the bus. Within 24 hours, I found it listed on PataChako by the transport company. The verification was smooth and secure.

massoud.name: Massoud Rashid
massoud.text: As an optometrist traveling from Kivukoni toward Kigamboni for a clinic visit, I accidentally left my portable eye examination equipment in a vehicle and could not remember where I had dropped it. Fortunately, someone reported the item through PataChako and left it with a nearby organization, making it much easier and safer for me to recover it.

seif.name: Seif Ali
seif.text: As a civil engineer working on construction sites, I travel frequently and often carry important equipment and documents. After leaving my surveying equipment in a transport vehicle, PataChako helped me report it and gave me peace of mind knowing it could be securely recovered.
